A '''stronghold''' that was ancient<ref name="ARCH" /> by [[3646 BBY]]<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Pilgrimage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> was occupied by a small [[Chevin pilgrim sect|sect]] consisting of members of the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]]<ref name="ARCH" /> [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chevin}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two opposing governments in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had a companion follow the Chevin pilgrims on a pilgrimage to a [[Unidentified blue sun|blue sun]] to learn their history. The Chevin welcomed the companion and at the end of the pilgrimage showed them into their stronghold. There, the sect instructed the companion in the ways of their [[Chevin pilgrim idol|idol]] and offered aid.<ref name="ARCH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chevin stronghold is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Archaeology Crew Skill mission "Pilgrimage," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="ARCH" />
